status: PROPOSED, NOT RELEASED. This file declares stage bindings and bookkeeping limits only; it authorizes no receiver call and no candidate execution.
interpretation_rules: A tie is inconclusive and does not evidence a resampling mechanism.
No significance-driven escalation and no futility claim from six draws per arm.

gating.rule: a root is a checkpoint iff analyze_diagnostic.public_status(diag, root) == "any_fail", i.e. any frozen public case status is wrong_value/format_error/interface_error/program_exception; timeout/unavailable/output_limit are "unknown" and are NOT checkpoints

limits_note: artifact_starts = 5 roots x 2 arms x 6 replicates; recheck_starts = 2 per root (reference + negative control); containment_starts = 9 containment-gate payloads. 79 is a MAXIMUM: cache hits or pre-execution format rejection reduce actual starts without dropping any assigned grade row. These values match experiments/landmark/e13a_release/release_manifest.json exactly and are read through study_adapter.load_grading_limits; this file is not a release manifest.
roots_order_note: assignment-table order from collect_diagnostic.assignments; ordering is scheduling only

contrast.label: diagnostic-plus-R1-instruction restart package minus bare task resampling
contrast.direction_note: a positive value favours the restart package; a tie is inconclusive and does not identify a resampling mechanism

recheck_starts_note: The 10 recheck starts are reference/control validation starts, not continuation slots; they are budgeted in grading_limits and reported in usage accounting, and are deliberately not analysis slots.

exact_commands.setup_verify_attestation: .venv/bin/python scripts/e13a_stage_clock.py --run-dir "$RUN" --stage experiments/landmark/e13a_stage.json --ownership "$RESERVATION" --supervise setup -- .venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; from experiments.landmark.grade import verify_attestation; verify_attestation(sys.argv[1])' "$RUN/attestation/attestation.json"
exact_commands.setup_preflight: .venv/bin/python scripts/e13a_stage_clock.py --run-dir "$RUN" --stage experiments/landmark/e13a_stage.json --ownership "$RESERVATION" --supervise setup -- .venv/bin/python scripts/receiver_preflight_mrl10.py --tasks experiments/landmark/dev_release_v2/tasks.jsonl --examples docs/public_diagnostic_examples_v1.json --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8193 --out "$RUN/preflight"
exact_commands.note: These are phase interfaces, not execution authorization. Before use, set RUN to one new work/e13a_<actualUTC> directory, RESERVATION to the committed accepted window, OWNERSHIP to the separate committed post-launch PID record, and LAUNCHER_SHA to the current committed release execution_source_hashes entry. Initialize the run/stage-bound clock once before setup; run setup commands in the listed order through the supervisor, then commit runtime evidence and freeze before collection. Collection and grading enforce their own phase caps; analysis requires --supervise, not check/charge bookkeeping. Stop the owned receiver immediately after collection or on failure; dictionary order is not a shell workflow. Preserve all assigned slots and stop further dispatch on failure. Authoritative gates, caps and cleanup: docs/e13a_execution_contract_20260923.md.

analysis_missingness: If any assigned grade is unavailable, report no primary point contrast; show finite all-assigned completion bounds and label available-case summaries as secondary. Bounds are not confidence intervals.
